summary: Premium institutional website for NEXIRIS GLOBAL PVT LTD (a part of Nexiris Consultants), a global advisory firm. Company name updated site-wide to 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd' — all instances of 'Nexiris Consultants LLP' and 'Nexiris Consultants' replaced. Two-page structure: (1) Home with Hero (looping ship-sailing video background from Pexels), Problem, What We Deliver (minimal icon-card grid, analyst consultation removed), Trade Trust Score™, Annual Program highlight (including $649 Single Report tier), Credibility stats (clean typography), Final CTA; (2) Pricing page with $5,499/year annual plan, $649 single report tier, FAQ accordion, and footer. Contact info: nexirisconsultants@gmail.com, Unit no. 419, DLF CORPORATE GREENS, Sector 74A, Gurugram, Haryana 122004. ISO certification and GDPR compliant claims removed. SEO optimisation applied (meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD structured data, semantic HTML, keyword-rich copy). Brand palette: Frost White (base/backgrounds) + Minty Blue (accents, buttons, headings, borders). Typography: Montserrat for all headings, Inter for body copy. Minimal design. Inquiry modal has solid opaque background. Rich scroll-triggered animations retained.
architectural_notes: Two-page structure: index.html (Home) and pricing.html (Annual Program/Pricing)
Typography: Elegant serif for headings, clean modern sans-serif for body; strong hierarchy, generous spacing
Inquiry form is a modal overlay (no backend); displays confirmation message on submit
Colour palette updated to official logo colours: Deep Indigo #2E1F8C (primary), Rich Gold #E8A820 (accents), Slate Purple #4A3A7A (secondary)
Colour palette changed to Frost White + Minty Blue only (Deep Indigo / Slate Purple / Rich Gold removed)
Typography updated to Montserrat (headings) + Inter (body) — Playfair Display removed
Design philosophy: minimal — infographics stripped back, How It Works section removed, stat cards are typography-only

SEO layer added: meta title/description, Open Graph/Twitter Card tags, JSON-LD organisation schema, semantic HTML improvements, keyword-rich copy for Indian exporter verification / counterparty risk intelligence keywords
Hero section uses a looping muted autoplay <video> background (Pexels ship sailing video) with dark overlay instead of a static image

existing_features.title: Apply a consistent global visual theme across both pages: Deep Royal Purple (#2C1654 or equivalent) as primary brand color, Rich Gold / Saffron Yellow (#C9963A or equivalent) for accents, buttons, and score indicators, clean white backgrounds, and dark charcoal / deep purple for body text. Use an elegant serif (e.g., Playfair Display) for headings and a refined sans-serif (e.g., Inter) for body copy. Enforce generous whitespace, strong typographic hierarchy, no gradients, no flashy animations, and subtle hover effects only. The overall aesthetic must resemble a boutique institutional advisory firm.

Implement a two-page React application with client-side routing: a Home page (route '/') and an Annual Program / Pricing page (route '/annual-program'). Include a minimal sticky navigation bar displaying the Nexiris Consultants LLP wordmark on the left and navigation links ('Home', 'Annual Program') on the right, styled in Deep Royal Purple with gold hover accents.

Build the Hero section on the Home page: use a global trade / logistics / shipping ports background image (from generated assets), apply a minimal dark overlay for readability. Display headline 'Structured Counterparty Risk Intelligence for Global Trade.' in large serif font, subheading 'Independent verification, risk analytics, and strategic advisory for international buyers engaging with Indian exporters.' in sans-serif. Include a gold-filled primary CTA button labeled 'Request Verification' that opens the inquiry form modal, and an outline secondary CTA labeled 'View Sample Report' that smoothly scrolls to the 'What We Deliver' section.

Build a 3-column 'Why Importers Face Hidden Risk' section on the Home page. Each column contains a bold title and concise body text: (1) 'Structural Compliance Gaps' — Corporate registrations may exist — but inconsistencies, inactive status, or filing gaps can materially impact reliability. (2) 'Governance & Transparency Risks' — Director disqualifications, frequent entity changes, or opaque ownership structures may indicate elevated risk. (3) 'Undetected Regulatory & Reputational Exposure' — Public enforcement notices, litigation, or adverse media may significantly affect counterparty stability. Section headline: 'Why Importers Face Hidden Risk'. Keep layout minimal and structured.

Build the 'What We Deliver' section on the Home page with section headline 'What We Deliver' and a structured bullet / icon-list layout listing: Company Registration Verification (MCA), Director & Governance Review, GSTIN & Tax Status Validation, Export License (IEC) Verification, Trade Data & Export Track Record Analysis, Certification Verification, Adverse Media & Regulatory Screening, Quantitative Trade Trust Score™, Visual Risk Dashboard & Strategic Advisory Brief. Give this section an HTML anchor ID of 'what-we-deliver' so the hero's 'View Sample Report' CTA can scroll to it.

Build the Trade Trust Score™ section on the Home page. Include a circular risk gauge mockup (0–100 scale) and a radar chart mockup (five axes: Legal, Financial, Operational, Governance, Regulatory) rendered as SVG or Canvas-based static visual components — no live data needed. Display the text: 'A structured 100-point weighted risk model combining legal, financial, operational, governance, and regulatory indicators into a single decision-support framework. Designed to support procurement and management-level strategic decisions.' Use gold for score indicator elements and chart accents.

Build the Annual Program highlight box section on the Home page. Section headline: 'Annual Trade Risk Program'. Include a short intro text: 'For procurement teams onboarding multiple suppliers annually.' Render a structured highlight box with a gold accent border listing: 12 Premium Verification Reports, Quarterly Monitoring Updates, Executive Risk Briefing Support, Priority Turnaround, Structured Risk Dashboard, Preferential Pricing on Additional Services. Include a gold CTA button labeled 'Explore Annual Plan' that navigates to the '/annual-program' page.

Build the Credibility stats section on the Home page. Display four minimal stat blocks in a horizontal row: '25+' / 'Years Advisory Experience', 'Structured' / 'Verification Framework', 'Institutional' / 'Reporting Standards', 'Independent' / 'Unbiased Assessment'. No icons or excessive decoration — numbers/labels only, clean typographic treatment.

Build the Final CTA section on the Home page. Headline: 'Engage with Confidence. Transact with Clarity.' Include a gold filled button labeled 'Schedule Consultation' that opens the inquiry form modal.

Implement a reusable inquiry/contact form modal component. The modal is triggered by 'Request Verification' and 'Schedule Consultation' CTAs. It contains fields: Full Name (text), Company Name (text), Email Address (email), Message (textarea). Include a gold submit button labeled 'Send Inquiry'. On submission, display an in-modal confirmation message: 'Thank you. A member of our team will be in touch shortly.' Store submitted inquiries in the backend (Motoko actor) so they can be retrieved later. Close button (X) in the top-right corner dismisses the modal.

Build the Annual Program / Pricing page (route '/annual-program'). Display: Page headline 'Annual Trade Risk Program', price '$5,499 per year' in large prominent type, subtext '12 Structured Counterparty Verification Reports'. Render a structured 'What's Included' list: Full Desktop Verification, OSINT Research Layer, Trade Trust Score™, Visual Risk Dashboard, Red Flag Heat Matrix, Strategic Management Brief, 2 Supplier Re-Validations, Priority Support. Show 'Effective Rate: ~$458 per report' as a callout. Include an 'Optional Add-On' note: 'On-Ground Physical Verification (Custom Quote)'.

Build an FAQ accordion section on the Annual Program / Pricing page. Include the following five questions with institutional-grade answers written in brand tone: (1) 'What data sources are used?' — Answer: Our verification process draws on publicly available and legally accessible sources, including the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), GST Network, Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), and other government registries, supplemented by OSINT research and adverse media screening. (2) 'Is this a financial audit?' — Answer: No. Our assessments are advisory in nature, based on publicly available information. They do not constitute a statutory financial audit, legal opinion, or certification of any kind. (3) 'How long does delivery take?' — Answer: Standard delivery is 5–7 business days from confirmation of the subject entity details. Priority clients receive expedited turnaround. (4) 'Can this replace physical inspection?' — Answer: Our desktop verification and OSINT layer provide substantial risk intelligence; however, they complement rather than replace on-ground inspection where physical verification of facilities or operations is required. (5) 'How is risk scoring calculated?' — Answer: The Trade Trust Score™ is a structured 100-point model comprising weighted sub-scores across five dimensions: Legal & Compliance, Financial Indicators, Operational Track Record, Governance & Ownership, and Regulatory & Reputational Exposure.

Build a minimal site footer rendered on both pages. Display company name 'Nexiris Consultants LLP' and the disclaimer: 'Assessments are based on publicly available and legally accessible information and are advisory in nature. This does not constitute a financial audit or legal certification.' No excessive links. Keep it clean and minimal.

Render the generated hero background image (global trade / shipping / logistics scene) as a static asset at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-trade-bg.jpg'. Use it as the full-width background of the Hero section with a dark overlay (rgba black, ~55% opacity) for text readability.

Save the uploaded Nexiris Consultants LLP logo as a static asset at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png'. Replace the text wordmark in Navigation.tsx with an tag referencing this asset. Replace any text-based company name in Footer.tsx with the same logo image at an appropriate smaller size. Do not alter any immutable files.

Update the site-wide colour palette in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js to use the exact colours extracted from the official Nexiris logo: Deep Indigo #2E1F8C as the primary brand colour (replacing all previous purple/indigo primaries), Rich Gold #E8A820 as the accent/button colour (replacing all previous gold approximations), and Slate Purple #4A3A7A as the secondary/subtext colour. Apply these tokens consistently across all components — navigation active/hover states, CTA buttons, section headings, border accents, score indicators, and chart highlights — so the entire site reflects the logo's exact palette.

Add a '$649 Single Report' pricing tier card to the Annual Program / Pricing page (route '/annual-program') in PricingSection.tsx. Present it as a standalone single counterparty verification report. The card must list the same core deliverables as one report from the annual plan: Full Desktop Verification, OSINT Research Layer, Trade Trust Score™, Visual Risk Dashboard, Red Flag Heat Matrix, Strategic Management Brief. Include a gold CTA button labelled 'Request Single Report' that opens the inquiry form modal. Position the single report card visually alongside or below the existing $5,499/year annual plan card so both tiers are clearly comparable.

Implement rich scroll-triggered animations site-wide across both pages using CSS transitions and/or an Intersection Observer approach (e.g., via a lightweight utility or Framer Motion if already available). Apply the following animation patterns: (1) Smooth fade-in + slide-up entrance effects on all major sections as they scroll into view (Hero content, Problem columns, What We Deliver items, Trade Trust Score™ visuals, Annual Program highlight box, Credibility stats, Final CTA, Pricing cards, FAQ items). (2) Animated stat counters on the Credibility stats section — numbers count up from 0 to their display value when the section enters the viewport. (3) Parallax-style subtle vertical movement on the Hero background image as the user scrolls down. (4) Staggered entrance animations on multi-item lists and grid columns (each item animates in with a short delay after the previous). (5) Elegant hover micro-animations on all buttons (scale + brightness lift) and card elements (subtle upward float). Ensure all animations respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or minimising motion for users who have that system preference enabled.

Rename the navigation link from 'Annual Program' to 'Pricing' in Navigation.tsx. Update the page heading on the '/annual-program' route in AnnualProgram.tsx and PricingSection.tsx to display 'Pricing' as the primary label (retain 'Annual Trade Risk Program' as a subheading if appropriate). Update any other references to 'Annual Program' used as a nav label or page title across the codebase.

Fix the Nexiris logo rendering in Navigation.tsx and Footer.tsx. Ensure the src correctly points to '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png'. Verify the path resolves at runtime and the logo is visible in the sticky navbar (left side) and in the footer at an appropriately smaller size. Do not modify any immutable files.

Add a '$649 Single Report' pricing callout or card to the Home page inside AnnualProgramSection.tsx. Display it visually alongside or below the existing annual plan highlight box, clearly presenting the $649 price, the label 'Single Counterparty Verification Report', and the core deliverables (Full Desktop Verification, OSINT Research Layer, Trade Trust Score™, Visual Risk Dashboard, Red Flag Heat Matrix, Strategic Management Brief). Include a gold CTA button labelled 'Request Single Report' that opens the inquiry form modal.

Replace all heavy flat Deep Indigo / Slate Purple solid fills with gradient treatments site-wide. Apply indigo→white, indigo→light-lavender, or indigo→slate-purple→white gradients on: section backgrounds where solid purple currently dominates, the hero overlay, card backgrounds, the navigation bar background, and CTA strip backgrounds. Introduce significantly more white space across all sections — shift section backgrounds lighter (predominantly white or very light off-white/lavender) and use brand colours as accents rather than dominant fills. The overall page feel should be noticeably brighter and airier.

Update global typography across both pages: use Playfair Display (or Cormorant Garant as fallback) for all headings (h1–h3, section titles) and Inter for all body copy and UI labels. Ensure Google Fonts imports for both typefaces are present in frontend/src/index.css. Apply font classes via Tailwind config (font-heading / font-sans tokens already defined) consistently across all components — Navigation, Hero, Problem, WhatWeDeliver, TradeScore, AnnualProgram, Credibility, FinalCTA, Pricing, FAQ, Footer, and InquiryModal.

Expand scroll-triggered animations site-wide with richer entrance sequences and micro-interactions. In addition to existing fade-in/slide-up effects, add: (1) More pronounced staggered entrances on the Problem columns, What We Deliver grid cards, and Pricing cards — each item delays 80–120ms after the previous. (2) Enhanced hover micro-animations on all buttons (scale-up 1.05 + brightness lift + subtle shadow) and all card elements (translateY -4px float with shadow). (3) Section background colour/gradient transitions that subtly shift as the section enters the viewport. (4) Smooth number count-up animations on the Credibility stats section when it scrolls into view. (5) Parallax vertical offset on the Hero background image on scroll. All animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Redesign the 'What We Deliver' section (WhatWeDeliverSection.tsx) as a visual infographic icon-card grid. Each of the nine deliverables (Company Registration Verification, Director & Governance Review, GSTIN & Tax Status Validation, Export License IEC Verification, Trade Data & Export Track Record Analysis, Certification Verification, Adverse Media & Regulatory Screening, Quantitative Trade Trust Score™, Visual Risk Dashboard & Strategic Advisory Brief) should be presented as a card with a relevant icon, bold title, and one-line description. Maintain the 'what-we-deliver' anchor ID. Below the grid, add a horizontal 3–5 business day delivery timeline infographic showing a step-by-step visual flow: Step 1 'Client Submits Entity Details' → Step 2 'Research & Verification' → Step 3 'Risk Scoring & Analysis' → Step 4 'Report Delivery (3–5 Business Days)'. Use gold for timeline connector lines and step indicators.

Add a 'How It Works' process infographic section on the Home page (insert between WhatWeDeliverSection and TradeScoreSection). Display a numbered 4-step horizontal flow: (1) 'Submit Request' — Share the counterparty entity name and details; (2) 'Scope Confirmation' — We confirm the verification scope and turnaround; (3) 'Deep Verification' — Desktop research, OSINT, registry checks, and risk scoring; (4) 'Receive Report' — Structured Trade Trust Score™ report delivered within 3–5 business days. Use gold numbered circles as step indicators and indigo for step labels. Add scroll-triggered staggered entrance animation.

Enhance the Credibility stats section (CredibilitySection.tsx) with an infographic-style treatment. Replace plain stat blocks with visually structured cards or blocks that include an icon or decorative element above each number/label. Update the four stats to reflect accurate brand claims: '25+' / 'Years Advisory Experience', '200+' / 'Verifications Completed', 'Institutional' / 'Reporting Standards', 'Independent' / 'Unbiased Assessment'. Keep count-up animations. Apply a light gradient or white background card treatment consistent with the new brighter palette.

Update the global colour palette site-wide on both pages. Replace all current Deep Indigo, Slate Purple, Rich Gold, and any other legacy colours with a two-colour scheme: Frost White (#F8FFFE or equivalent near-white with a faint cool tint) as the base/background colour and Minty Blue (#3ECFB2 or equivalent vibrant mint-teal) as the primary accent colour for headings, CTA buttons, borders, active nav links, section highlights, score indicators, and chart accents. Update the colour tokens in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js accordingly, then apply these tokens consistently across all components: Navigation, HeroSection, ProblemSection, WhatWeDeliverSection, TradeScoreSection, AnnualProgramSection, CredibilitySection, FinalCTASection, PricingSection, FAQSection, Footer, and InquiryModal.

Replace Playfair Display (and any other current heading font) with Montserrat for all headings (h1–h3 and section titles) site-wide on both pages. Add the Montserrat Google Fonts import to frontend/src/index.css. Update the font-heading token in frontend/tailwind.config.js to reference Montserrat. Apply the font-heading class consistently across all heading elements in Navigation, HeroSection, ProblemSection, WhatWeDeliverSection, TradeScoreSection, AnnualProgramSection, CredibilitySection, FinalCTASection, PricingSection, FAQSection, Footer, and InquiryModal. Keep Inter (or the existing sans-serif) for body copy and UI labels.

Fix the InquiryModal component so its dialog/panel has a fully opaque, solid background (white or Frost White). Remove any transparency, backdrop blur that makes the form unreadable, or missing background class. The modal overlay (scrim behind the dialog) should remain semi-transparent dark, but the modal panel itself must be completely opaque so all form fields, labels, and buttons are clearly visible against a solid surface.

Simplify the site design to a minimal aesthetic by: (1) Removing the HowItWorksSection component entirely from Home.tsx (do not render it between WhatWeDeliverSection and TradeScoreSection); (2) Simplifying the WhatWeDeliverSection — replace the heavy infographic icon-card grid with a clean structured list or minimal two-column layout, and remove the step-by-step delivery timeline infographic below the grid; (3) Reverting the CredibilitySection stat blocks to clean typography-only treatment — remove decorative icons and card wrapping, display just the number/label pairs in a horizontal row with generous whitespace; (4) Generally reducing visual complexity across all sections — favour whitespace, clean typography, and restrained use of borders and accents over icon-heavy or infographic-heavy layouts.

Remove all mentions of 'ISO certification' and 'GDPR compliant' (or 'GDPR compliance') from every component across both pages — including CredibilitySection.tsx, Footer.tsx, PricingSection.tsx, FAQSection.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, and any other file where these claims appear.
In WhatWeDeliverSection.tsx, remove 'Analyst Consultation' from the deliverables list. The remaining eight deliverables should continue to render correctly in the two-column layout.

In Footer.tsx, add a contact information block displaying the email address 'nexirisconsultants@gmail.com' (as a clickable mailto link) and the physical address 'Unit no. 419, DLF CORPORATE GREENS, Sector 74A, Gurugram, Haryana 122004'. Place this within the existing contact column or a clearly labelled 'Contact' section of the footer.

Implement comprehensive on-page SEO in frontend/index.html and across both page components. (1) Update the <title> tag in frontend/index.html to 'Nexiris Consultants LLP | Indian Exporter Verification & Counterparty Risk Intelligence'. (2) Add a <meta name='description'> tag with keyword-rich content: 'Nexiris Consultants LLP provides independent counterparty risk verification, trade due diligence, supplier risk assessment, and Trade Trust Score™ reports for international buyers sourcing from Indian exporters.' (3) Add Open Graph meta tags: og:title, og:description, og:type (website), og:site_name ('Nexiris Consultants LLP'), og:url. (4) Add Twitter Card meta tags: twitter:card (summary_large_image), twitter:title, twitter:description. (5) Add a JSON-LD Organisation structured data script block in the <head> with name 'Nexiris Consultants LLP', url, address (Unit no. 419, DLF CORPORATE GREENS, Sector 74A, Gurugram, Haryana 122004), email (nexirisconsultants@gmail.com), and description. (6) Ensure all major sections across both pages use semantic HTML elements (section, article, header, nav, main, footer, h1–h3) with proper heading hierarchy. (7) Where appropriate, weave SEO-relevant keywords naturally into section headings and introductory copy — including terms such as 'Indian exporter verification', 'counterparty risk intelligence', 'supplier due diligence', 'trade risk assessment', 'import risk management', 'MCA verification', 'OSINT trade research' — without altering the core brand voice or layout.

Replace all instances of 'Nexiris Consultants LLP', 'Nexiris Consultants', and any other variations of the old company name across the entire codebase with 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd'. This includes: the Navigation.tsx wordmark/logo alt text, Footer.tsx company name and disclaimer text, frontend/index.html title tag, meta description, Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:site_name), Twitter Card tags, and the JSON-LD Organisation structured data block (name, description fields). Also update any in-component text references in HeroSection.tsx, PricingSection.tsx, FAQSection.tsx, AnnualProgramSection.tsx, CredibilitySection.tsx, FinalCTASection.tsx, InquiryModal.tsx, and any other component where the old company name appears. Do not modify any immutable files.

In HeroSection.tsx, replace the current static background image with a looping, muted, autoplay HTML5 <video> element using the Pexels video URL https://www.pexels.com/download/video/28647987/ as the video src. The video must be set to autoPlay, muted, loop, and playsInline. It should be positioned absolutely to fill the full Hero section (object-fit: cover, width: 100%, height: 100%). Retain the existing dark overlay (rgba black, ~55% opacity) layered on top of the video for text readability. All existing Hero content (headline, subheading, CTA buttons, stats row) must remain fully visible and correctly layered above the overlay. Remove any reference to the static hero background image (hero-trade-bg.jpg) from HeroSection.tsx. The parallax scroll effect previously applied to the background image should be removed or adapted to work with the video element.
